# Meegle

> Meegle is a free visual workflow and project management platform designed for cross-functional teams, offering task management, automation, and multi-view project visibility.

Meegle provides a modern alternative to tools like Jira and Monday.com, with particular strength in game development, software development, and agile workflows. The platform emphasizes visual workflow management, team collaboration, and intelligent automation to help teams deliver projects faster.

## Key Topics

- Visual Workflow Management
- Project Management
- Workflow Automation
- Task Management
- Team Collaboration
- Agile Development
- Game Development
- Cross-functional Teams
- Resource Allocation
- Gantt & Kanban Views
- Integration (Slack, GitHub, Zapier)
- Team Roles & Permissions
- Workflow Optimization
- Data Visualization & Analytics
- Software Development

## Core Features

- [Enhance Productivity with Meegle's Visual Workflow Features](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/workflow): Visual workflow features for tasks, dependencies, and milestones
- [Improve Project Visibility with Meegle's Multiple Views](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/views): Table, Kanban, Gantt, and Tree views for project visibility
- [Freeing up Manpower to More Meaningful Work with Meegle Automation](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/automation): Workflow automation with triggers, conditions, actions templates
- [Optimize with Meegle: Advanced Role & Team Management Features](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/teams-and-roles): Team management, role assignment, and cross-functional collaboration
- [Plan. Organize. Optimize. With Meegle.](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/scheduling): Scheduling, task management, and resource allocation features
- [Visualize Data and Gain Deeper Insights in Meegle](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/charts): Dynamic dashboards, charts, and analytics for data visualization
- [Elevate Projects with Meegle's Smart Interactive Controls](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/toolkit): Smart interactive controls for efficiency and team transparency
- [Connect Your Apps. Enhance Workflow with Meegle's Integration.](https://www.meegle.com/meegle_features/integration): Integrations with Slack, GitHub, GitLab, Zapier for workflows
